PRIVACY POLICY

The serious face.

FACE WATCH FACE · UPDATED SEPTEMBER 16, 2026

App policy awaiting developer confirmation.

This page describes this website. The watch app’s data practices, developer contact, and retention details have not yet been supplied. This is not yet a complete app privacy policy for Google Play submission.

About this website

Face Watch Face is a product website with an interactive artwork preview. The preview runs in your browser. It does not access your watch, health information, location, camera, or contacts.

Information used by the website

The site’s own code does not include analytics, advertising trackers, account registration, a contact form, or purchases. It does not set cookies or save information in browser storage. Selecting a face or trying the face cream changes only the current page; that selection is not saved when you reload.

Hosting and external services

Your browser sends technical information, such as your IP address and browser details, to the hosting service when loading pages and images. The hosting provider may process request and security logs under its own practices. Hosting retention details must be confirmed before public launch. A private preview may also use the hosting platform’s separate sign-in and access controls.

External links take you to services with their own privacy policies. This website does not receive your payment details from an app store.

The watch app and permissions

The product artwork describes time, battery, temperature, heart rate, and precipitation features. Artwork alone does not establish whether the app accesses, stores, or shares those data. The app policy must identify the actual permissions, data providers, SDKs, collection, sharing, and security practices before release.

Retention and deletion

The artwork preview creates no user account or saved profile, so there is no preview account to delete. Browser interactions end when the page is closed. App data, support-message retention, and hosting-log retention require separate confirmation. See data and deletion for current guidance.

Privacy questions

A verified developer privacy contact has not yet been added. The support page will provide the contact once confirmed.

Changes to this policy

The date above will change when this page is updated. The final app policy must reflect the version actually distributed.
